implementation.targetScope: Platform-specific data/config/cache/log/temp paths with current filename validation, live environment overrides and a CommonJS bridge for unchanged Capacitor 8.2.0 env-paths 2.2.1 callers. Native path/os only; no package dependencies.

differences: Includes CommonJS callable/default identity alongside the current ESM default API.

Validation rejects empty, dot-only, slash, backslash and NUL names before and after suffixing, matching env-paths 4.0.0. Legacy 2.2.1 accepted these inputs; its explicit undefined suffix also differed from the current default.
Filename validation is implemented locally instead of depending on is-safe-filename.
No directories are created and no environment variables are changed. Environment override paths are trusted as in upstream; this is not a filesystem sandbox or general Windows filename validator.
Windows/Linux/FreeBSD path rules are simulated with the native path implementations. Native Windows execution is not claimed.
No public release or application adoption claimed.
